specific_reading_findings.fact: p for upper held material, mp near another entering layer; A pp ostinato versus later lower-staff p melody and local hand cue.
specific_reading_findings.judgment: Preserve separate roles and entry time; do not merge nearby dynamic letters or center every marking.

specific_reading_findings.fact: Upstem short high groups, slower downstem melody and lower accompaniment coexist; short group slurs and longer lines have different tasks.
specific_reading_findings.judgment: Preserve independent rests and identity. Returning material has changed accents/low layer; no complete-coordinate copying.

specific_reading_findings.fact: Continuous ordinary double-beamed sixteenths, mixtures of flat and shallow sloped groups; C first group has interior note nearer upper beam.
specific_reading_findings.judgment: Preserve local beam-shape response; no global flat or pitch-polyline rule. High-resolution C check confirms old double-beam observation.

specific_reading_findings.fact: Dotted guide leads to lower-staff long note; later running material rises across staves while another line remains.
specific_reading_findings.judgment: Keep layer/route evidence and necessary clef changes. Internal voice containers and complete pitch/hand recipe not inferred.

specific_reading_findings.fact: Whole-note paired3-stroke tremolo, later stemmed/partial-bar forms, written3/5/6 groups and ordinary run, then ff pesante slow theme with repeating background.
specific_reading_findings.judgment: Paired heads share the tremolo duration, not two successive full durations. Preserve technique changes and local8vb. Exact repetition rate not established.

specific_reading_findings.fact: dim. poco a poco,calando,long upper line; lower complete ties and open resonance arcs then rests,Ped. and release star.
specific_reading_findings.judgment: Preserve sounding-resonance aid with rests; do not auto-complete open arcs or erase pedal/rest structure.

specific_reading_findings.fact: M independent long layer; N a tempo/ppp cresc. poco a poco, brief bass clef in upper staff; final a tempo/ff,low r.h. half-note indications, later fff and tied fermata ending.
specific_reading_findings.judgment: Keep true roles and stages. High-resolution N confirms ppp, not pp. Existing record retained; no new preference or native result.

page_findings.583: Combined player parts: clear performer identity, brackets/bars and changed division labels. Shared tempo/rehearsal above, dynamics/technical instructions readable for each actual player; close divisi may need separate staves.
page_findings.584: String divisions: separate physical groups need parts; dense multi-divisi may split desks. Separate stems distinguish divisi from double stops; preserve performer staff through system.
page_findings.585: Plan part layout for all divisi permutations across a whole system; may differ from score. Duplicate necessary unison and player information rather than force mid-system staff changes.
page_findings.586: Solo line keeps own top staff for complete system; label complex groups. Percussion reading must account for physical distance,movement,sticks and minimal distraction; repeat symbols sparing.
page_findings.587: Individual/playing percussion score choice balances allocation flexibility and mutual cues against simultaneous turn feasibility,more staves and physical access; no piano turn-time multiplier borrowed.
page_findings.588: Stable player order and labelled condensation aid identification; brackets/bars clarify system boundaries. Nearby/unique audible cues and mid-pattern landmarks support orientation.
